newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish FinMin says spending plan to proceed.
newsitem.headline: Swedish FinMin says spending plan to proceed.

text.p: Swedish Finance Minster Erik Asbrink said on Wednesday that a 10 billion crown spending package would proceed even if budgetary developments were worse than expected.
Asbrink told reporters: "We have said 10 billion and we will stick to that."
However Asbrink said the government was prepared to take other measures to strengthen the budget if the economy deteriorated. He gave no details.

The government has announced a 10 billion crown package sponsored by a forecast budget surplus next year and dedicated to spending on the elderly and health care. -- Simon Haydon, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1004
